investigation: Camofox navigation timeout and Reddit 52-character baseline result
workingTree: Uncommitted source fixes; no release build or promotion

navigation.cause: Unbounded background-work draining after the page-readiness action completes holds the tab lock. The outer navigation timeout does not cancel the drain.
navigation.control: Same pinned 2.4.7 image, identical copied fingerprint, separate fresh-cookie profiles, private network; only exact upstream 2.4.8 drain patch differs before equivalent instrumentation.
limits: The unbounded drain already exists in 2.4.6; this does not establish that 2.4.7 introduced it.
Tracker setup and finalization still contain unbounded browser awaits; neither blocked this experiment.
The exact upstream patch preserves fail-closed handling of unresolved navigation guards.
Successful isolated counterfactual is not appliance regression approval or authorization to promote 2.4.8.

reddit.cause: Camofox replaces oversized serialized evaluation results with a diagnostic string. CRW ignored truncated:true and treated this string as HTML; markdown bracket escaping yields the observed 52 characters.
limits: Different independent profiles loaded different feed sizes; the cause of that size difference is not established.
HTTP 200 from Camofox is not proof of Reddit origin status.
Rejecting truncated documents prevents false success; it does not recover the oversized content. Bounded document transfer remains future work.
reddit.sourceFix: Camofox renderer deserializes optional truncated flag, defaults omitted flag to false, and returns RendererError for true after existing tab cleanup.

validation.red: New exact-placeholder regression failed against previous code: diagnostic accepted as HTML.
validation.greenCommand: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo test --locked -p crw-renderer --features cdp,camofox; cargo clippy --locked -p crw-renderer --features cdp,camofox --all-targets -- -D warnings
validation.runtime: Remote Docker rust-ci:1.98; Rust 1.98.1; source fixes tested, not rebuilt into deployed validation appliance.

operations.sanitization: No raw page HTML, body previews, cookies, fingerprints, runtime credentials, or environment dumps copied into repository.
